$schema_note: Jisr Crisis Gate + episode-opening + Step Matcher rules. Loaded by services/api/app/engines/{crisis_gate,step_matcher,rci,sla}.py. Stages run in order; inside a stage the first matching rule wins unless noted. Output is a SUGGESTION; a clinician confirms every step (API-12). Mirrors PROJECT_BRIEF.md §5–6 (revision of 2026-11-18).
status: draft — requires clinical lead sign-off before any non-synthetic use

FF_CSSRS_ITEMS.reason: C-SSRS screener licence terms for digital use not yet confirmed (R-05). Rules CG-04/CG-05 are inactive while false.

LLM_CRISIS_SECOND_OPINION.reason: M-02 raise-only classifier; always off in Judge Mode (judges' free text must not leave the system).

citations.DOH_SOC_2025: DoH Standard of Care for Depression & Anxiety (effective Sep 2025) — PHQ-2/GAD-2 then PHQ-9/GAD-7 in primary care. https://www.doh.gov.ae/-/media/Feature/Resources/Standards/2025/Standard-of-Care-Depression--Anxiety.ashx
citations.NICE_CG123: NICE CG123 Common mental health problems: identification and pathways to care (stepped care). https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/cg123
citations.KROENKE_2001: Kroenke et al. 2001, PHQ-9 severity bands. https://doi.org/10.1046/j.1525-1497.2001.016009606.x
citations.SPITZER_2006: Spitzer et al. 2006, GAD-7 severity bands. https://doi.org/10.1001/archinte.166.10.1092
citations.NHS_TT_MANUAL: NHS Talking Therapies for anxiety and depression manual — reliable change (PHQ-9 >= 6, GAD-7 >= 4) and caseness (PHQ-9 >= 10, GAD-7 >= 8). https://www.england.nhs.uk/publication/the-improving-access-to-psychological-therapies-manual/
citations.CSSRS: Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale, screener version. https://cssrs.columbia.edu/ — digital-use licence to verify (R-05).
citations.BRIEF: Jisr PROJECT_BRIEF.md §5 (F-03, F-22, cross-cutting safety rules) and §6 (levels, SLAs, episode opening).
citations.JISR_DESIGN: Jisr design decision (no external source); listed for transparency and clinical review.

inputs.cssrs_screener: object {q1..q6: bool|null, q6_recent_3m: bool|null} | null — only read when FF_CSSRS_ITEMS=true
inputs.free_text_flags: list of lexicon hits from crisis_lexicon.v1.json (F-22 box and any other free text)
inputs.gate_error: bool — true if the gate threw, timed out, or could not load its rules
inputs.self_referral: bool — the person asked for support regardless of score
inputs.comorbidity_flag: bool — physical comorbidity from E-16 PhysicalContext (needs consent scope share-physical-context; false if no consent)
inputs.clinician_review_flags: list — e.g. perinatal, psychosis_symptoms_reported, substance_use_reported; shown to the clinician, do not change the level automatically
inputs.preferences: object {language, clinician_gender, modality, area, insurance_plan, wants_human_support}

stage_1_crisis_gate.description: Runs first, before scoring display, step matching or any LLM call, on every screening completion and every free-text input (incl. F-22). Any hit -> RED. Fail-closed. Nothing downstream (rules, M-02, UI defaults) can clear RED; a coordinator may acknowledge, only a clinician may close a RED episode.

rules.note: Error, timeout or rules not loaded -> treat as RED: show emergency guidance, open RED episode for human review.
Brief F-03: same-day human safety check, not an automatic emergency call. Clinical advisors to confirm (OQ-01). Still RED with 15-minute acknowledgement.

rules.if: phq9 was started AND phq9_item9 == null
rules.note: Missing item 9 is never treated as 0 (fail-closed principle applied to missing data).

rules.if: m02_raise == true (arrives asynchronously after the gate answered)
rules.note: M-02 may only add this flag. raise=false, errors, timeouts have no effect.

on_red.ack_by: coordinator or clinician (API-24); contact attempts logged (API-25); close only by clinician
on_red.person_ui: Lock LLM panel; template copy only; show 999 first when severity == imminent, then 800-SAKINA (800 725462) and 800-HOPE (800 4673) as tel: links
on_red.free_text_storage: F-22: store only gate result + matched category + entry id; raw text stored only with consent scope 'store free text'

rules.if: phq9_total out of 0-27 OR gad7_total out of 0-21 OR any item value out of range OR non-integer
items present AND supplied total != recomputed total
rules.note: If items absent (FHIR import), accept supplied total and flag 'imported_total_unverified'.
Adults 18+ only (brief §10). Crisis Gate still ran first; coordinator routes to child & adolescent services.

rules.if: (phq2_total >= 3 AND phq9_total == null) OR (gad2_total >= 3 AND gad7_total == null)
rules.note: Do not infer a level from a 2-item pre-screen.

stage_3_episode_opening.description: Brief §6 'When does an episode open?'. A RED from stage 1 always opens (or flips) an episode.

rules.note: Person gets an explanation and an optional re-check reminder.

stage_4_severity.description: Higher of the two instruments wins: severity_level = max(level_from_phq9, level_from_gad7). A missing instrument contributes nothing (VA-04 already caught pre-screen-only cases).

gad7_to_level.note: GAD-7 >= 15 is L3; it becomes L4 only with a complexity flag (SM-03).

stage_5_modifiers.description: Applied in order to severity_level. Modifiers only ever move the level up; cap at L4. L0 and L1 are only reached by self-referral (EO-03); the person's choice can lift L0 to L1.

rules.note: Complexity = functional impairment 'extremely difficult' (phq9_difficulty == 3), prior specialist care, or clinician judgement.

rules.if: previous_step == 'L2' AND rci_status in ['no_reliable_change','deteriorated'] at a re-check
rules.note: Minimum time at L2 before step-up is a clinical decision (open question); engine suggests, clinician confirms.

rules.if: previous_step == 'L3' AND rci_status in ['no_reliable_change','deteriorated'] at a re-check

rules.then: no level change; add factor 'clinician review recommended'
rules.note: Perinatal, psychosis symptoms or substance use are surfaced, not auto-escalated (brief defines L4 complexity narrowly). Clinical lead to decide whether any should auto-lift.

stage_6_rci.description: Computed on every re-check (API-10). Drives step-up / step-down SUGGESTIONS only.
logic: deteriorated if (current_total - baseline_total) >= threshold on ANY instrument
improved if delta >= threshold on at least one instrument AND no instrument deteriorated
mixed (one improved, one deteriorated) -> 'deteriorated' (raise-only) + flag 'mixed_change' for the clinician
step_down suggestion: improved AND both instruments below caseness (PHQ-9 < 10, GAD-7 < 8) at 2 consecutive re-checks
no baseline -> rci_status = null (no step change suggested)

stage_7_preference_matching.description: Does not change the level. Modality (in-person / tele) is a preference WITHIN a level. Ranks providers at the chosen level; every factor shown with its weight. Hard filters first, then score.
hard_filters: provider.networks includes person.insurance_plan — if none match, show the nearest in-network option and an explicit 'out of network' warning
stage_7_preference_matching.no_match: 0 providers pass hard filters -> coordinator task NO_CAPACITY (24 h) and L1 waiting-well bridge (F-09) meanwhile

sla.description: Brief §6 SLA proposals; configurable in .env. Breach -> ESCALATED + notification.
sla.notes: SLA_STEP_CONFIRM_HOURS is a Jisr proposal not listed in the brief. First appointment is measured from the positive screen, not from referral.

fields: state (RED | NEEDS_DATA | NO_EPISODE | OUT_OF_SCOPE | REJECT | SUGGESTED)
red_severity (imminent | high | same_day_check | review) when RED
output_contract.invariant: requires_clinician_confirmation is always true. No code path sets STEP_CONFIRMED or closes a RED episode without a clinician StaffUser id.
